title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
We are looking for a Senior UX Designer to join our design team and work on a large-scale banking platform that directly impacts Corporate and Institutional Banking customers.
  
The platform provides corporates with a single place to manage their banking needs, including accounts, deposits, account summary, cash flow analytics, tax payments, inflow and outflow tracking, IPO bidding, GST payments, A/R and A/P reconciliation, and many more banking and financial services.
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in designing banking products and be comfortable working on complex workflows, owning modules/verticals end-to-end, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across business, product, and engineering teams.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned modules/verticals, from understanding the problem and requirements through design and implementation.
* Solve complex UX problems that directly impact corporate and institutional banking users.
* Understand business requirements, user needs, technical constraints, and translate them into simple and intuitive user experiences.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, Product Managers, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with multiple stakeholders and effectively manage feedback, dependencies, and design decisions.
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma.
* Create and maintain master product flows that bring together key banking journeys and capabilities for internal and external product demonstrations.
* Clearly articulate and visualize crisp UX solutions, making complex banking concepts and workflows easy for business stakeholders to understand.
* Present UX solutions effectively through structured walkthroughs, prototypes, flows, and visual storytelling.
* Design scalable and reusable solutions that can support evolving business requirements and future use cases.
* Follow established design systems and contribute to improving and scaling the design system.
* Ensure consistency across modules/verticals, workflows, and banking products.
* Work closely with engineering teams to ensure design intent and UX quality are maintained during implementation.
* Participate in design reviews, stakeholder walkthroughs, and product discussions.
* Balance user needs, business requirements, technical feasibility, and business objectives while making design decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify complex banking workflows and improve the overall user experience.
* Work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple parallel requirements.

**Must-Have Skills and Experience**

* 3-6 years of experience in UX/UI or Product Design.
* Banking experience is mandatory, with experience on at least one banking product or platform.
* Strong understanding of banking domain, workflows, and user journeys.
* Experience owning modules/verticals end-to-end.
* Strong collaboration with Business Analysts, Engineering teams, Product Managers, and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong UX fundamentals with the ability to simplify complex problems into clear, intuitive solutions.
* Strong knowledge of design systems and ability to create scalable, reusable solutions.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Ability to create and manage master product flows for internal and external product demos.
* Strong ability to articulate and visually communicate crisp UX solutions to business and technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

What we are looking for
  

* You should be comfortable understanding complex requirements, working with multiple stakeholders, collaborating closely with Business Analysts and Engineering teams, and translating business and user needs into simple, scalable, and effective experiences.
* The ideal candidate should also be able to clearly articulate UX thinking, visualize complex product journeys, and communicate design solutions effectively to both business and technical stakeholders.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Who are we?**

IDfy is Asia’s leading TrustStack, trusted by the best, with global expertise and enterprise-grade tech, we’re solving trust challenges, making compliance easy, fraud detection smarter, and onboarding seamless.

Our clients include
**HDFC Bank, Zomato, Amazon, PhonePe, Paytm, HUL**
and many others. With more than 13+ years of experience and 2 million verifications per day, we are pioneers in this industry.

IDfy’s three platforms- OnboardIQ, OneRisk, and Privy - come together to form one seamless solution enabling trust.

**WE’LL GET ALONG IF YOU...**

* Have 2–4 years in Product Design, with real work on complex B2B products. We are hiring at both PD1 and PD2 levels and will calibrate based on depth of ownership, not years alone.
* Can read and reason about technical systems. Privy’s Data Governance surface deals with data lineage, asset classification, scan pipelines, and structured and unstructured data stores. You will not design these well without understanding how the data moves.
* Are comfortable in code-first design workflows. Our team builds and hosts working prototypes instead of handing off static screens. You should be able to work in a repo, or be ready to learn fast.
* Have worked with design systems for multi-product platforms: tokens, components, and the discipline to keep production consistent with design.
* Have advanced Figma skills and real experience with AI-assisted design workflows. (Bonus: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity or similar.)
* Understand information architecture and interaction design for dense, data-heavy interfaces.
* Can hold your own with PMs and engineers: asking the right questions about feasibility, pushing back on scope, and driving alignment without a manager in the room.

**BONUS POINTS FOR**

* Experience designing for data platforms, observability tools, compliance workflows or developer-facing products.
* Familiarity with DPDPA, GDPR or similar privacy regulation and the workflows they create.
* Owning a product surface end to end, from discovery through QA.
* Interaction design, motion design or design system governance.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**

* Own Privy’s Data Governance surface end to end: Lineage, Asset Register, Operational Controls, Asset Rescan, Unstructured Assets and classification workflows.
* Design for technical users. DPOs, compliance teams and infosec teams use these modules daily. The work is about making complex data relationships legible, not about decoration.
* Work in the design repo. Build working prototypes, host them, and use them to validate flows with PMs, engineers and clients before dev investment.
* Partner directly with engineering on feasibility, data model constraints and scan behaviour, and translate those constraints into usable interfaces.
* Contribute to Privy’s design system: tokens, components and patterns that hold up across all products, not just your own.
* Run usability validation and stakeholder walkthroughs on your modules before handoff.
* Do design QA on what ships, so the shipped product matches the intent.
* At PD2: mentor juniors, raise design standards across the team, and shape how design operates at Privy.

title: Marketing Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a
**creative, detail-oriented, and execution-focused Graphic Designer**
who can translate marketing ideas into compelling visual and video content.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
**graphic design, hands-on video editing, and AI-powered creative tools**
. This role will work closely with marketing, content, and internal teams to create high-impact visual assets that strengthen brand presence and support marketing campaigns across digital and offline platforms.

If you enjoy turning concepts into visually engaging designs, creating short-form video content, experimenting with AI tools, and working in a fast-paced marketing environment, this role will give you the opportunity to create meaningful and high-impact work.

Key Responsibilities

1. Graphic Design & Marketing Creatives

* Design high-quality marketing collaterals including
  **brochures, banners, social media creatives, emailers, presentations, advertisements, promotional assets, and event materials**
  .
* Create visual assets for
  **websites, campaign landing pages, blogs, digital campaigns, and other marketing channels**
  .
* Develop creatives for
  **product launches, campaigns, brand initiatives, events, webinars, and internal marketing activities**
  .
* Translate marketing briefs and campaign objectives into visually compelling designs.
* Create multiple creative concepts and formats based on campaign requirements and target audiences.
* Adapt designs across different platforms, dimensions, and communication formats while maintaining visual quality.

2. Video Editing & Motion Graphics

* Create and edit
  **short-form videos, promotional videos, social media videos, product videos, event videos, and marketing content**
  .
* Edit raw footage into engaging and polished video content suitable for digital and social platforms.
* Add
  **text, transitions, animations, graphics, music, voiceovers, subtitles, and other visual elements**
  to videos.
* Create basic to intermediate
  **motion graphics and animated content**
  for marketing campaigns.
* Repurpose existing marketing content into different video formats for platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube, websites, and other digital channels.
* Work with marketing and content teams to develop video concepts aligned with campaign objectives.
* Ensure videos are delivered in the appropriate formats, resolutions, aspect ratios, and specifications for different platforms.

3. AI-Powered Creative Production

* Use
  **AI-powered design and video tools**
  to improve creative production speed, quality, and experimentation.
* Leverage AI tools for
  **image generation, video generation, creative ideation, mockups, background removal, image enhancement, content variations, and visual experimentation**
  .
* Explore and experiment with emerging AI tools to improve creative workflows and production efficiency.
* Use AI-assisted workflows to create multiple creative concepts and variations quickly.
* Combine traditional design skills with AI tools while maintaining
  **brand consistency, quality, originality, and creative judgment**
  .
* Stay updated on new AI-powered design, image, and video creation tools relevant to marketing and brand communication.

4. Brand Consistency

* Ensure all creative assets strictly follow
  **brand guidelines, visual identity, typography, color, layout, and design standards**
  .
* Maintain consistent visual communication across digital and offline marketing channels.
* Support the development and evolution of brand assets and visual templates.
* Ensure consistency across static designs, videos, presentations, social media content, and campaign materials.

5. Campaign & Event Design

* Develop creative assets for
  **marketing campaigns, product launches, webinars, conferences, events, and promotional activities**
  .
* Create event-specific designs including banners, invitations, presentations, social media creatives, booth graphics, signage, and promotional materials.
* Work closely with marketing and content teams to understand campaign objectives and timelines.
* Deliver creative assets within agreed deadlines and campaign schedules.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with
  **marketing, content, product, sales, and internal stakeholders**
  to understand creative requirements.
* Convert briefs and business objectives into effective visual and video communication.
* Proactively suggest creative ideas, formats, and approaches to improve marketing communication.
* Manage feedback and revisions efficiently while maintaining creative quality.
* Communicate timelines, dependencies, and creative requirements clearly to stakeholders.

7. Creative Asset Management

* Maintain organized design files, source files, templates, brand assets, and creative libraries.
* Ensure final creative files are properly formatted and ready for digital publishing or print production.
* Maintain version control and ensure that the latest approved creative assets are used across campaigns.
* Build reusable templates and design systems to improve creative production efficiency.

Functional Competencies

* Strong
  **visual design, typography, composition, color, and layout skills**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **branding and marketing communication**
  .
* Ability to create both
  **static and video-based marketing content**
  .
* Strong creative thinking and ability to translate ideas into compelling visual concepts.
* High attention to detail and strong quality orientation.
* Ability to understand
  **marketing objectives and target audiences**
  , not just aesthetics.
* Strong ability to manage multiple projects and creative requests simultaneously.
* Excellent time management and deadline orientation.
* Ability to work in a
  **fast-paced, high-volume marketing environment**
  .
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to take ownership of creative projects from
  **brief to final delivery**
  .

Technical Competencies

* Proficiency in
  **Adobe Creative Suite**
  , particularly:
* Photoshop
* Illustrator
* InDesign
* Proficiency in
  **Figma or similar design tools**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **video editing tools**
  , such as:
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects
* DaVinci Resolve
* Final Cut Pro
* or similar tools
* Knowledge of
  **motion graphics, animation, transitions, and video composition**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **AI-powered creative tools**
  for image generation, video generation, editing, enhancement, mockups, ideation, and creative experimentation.
* Understanding of
  **digital design standards**
  , image formats, video formats, resolutions, aspect ratios, and platform specifications.
* Understanding of
  **print production processes**
  , including preparing artwork for print.
* Ability to optimize creative assets for
  **web, social media, presentations, email campaigns, events, and print**

AI & Creative Technology

The candidate should be comfortable experimenting with modern AI-powered creative workflows.

Experience with tools such as
**Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Canva AI, Runway, Kling, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar AI tools**
will be valuable.

The candidate should be able to use AI tools to:

* Generate creative concepts and visual directions.
* Create or enhance images.

* Create mockups and visual variations.

* Experience working in a
  **corporate, agency, SaaS, technology, or marketing environment**
  is preferred.
* Demonstrated professional experience in
  **graphic design and video editing**
  .
* Practical experience using
  **AI-powered creative tools**
  .
* Strong portfolio demonstrating a combination of:
* Marketing and brand design
* Social media creatives
* Digital campaigns
* Presentations and marketing collateral
* Video editing
* Motion graphics/animation
* AI-assisted creative work

Portfolio Requirement

A
**strong portfolio is mandatory**
.

The portfolio should demonstrate the candidate's ability to create:

* Marketing and brand creatives
* Social media designs
* Campaign creatives
* Presentations and digital assets
* Website/landing page designs
* Short-form videos
* Promotional or marketing videos
* Motion graphics or animations
* AI-assisted creative work

Candidates should be able to explain the
**objective, creative approach, tools used, and their individual contribution**
to selected projects.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

* Combines
  **creative thinking with strong execution speed**
  .
* Is equally comfortable working on
  **static designs and video content**
  .
* Understands
  **marketing objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements**
  , not just aesthetics.
* Has strong fundamentals in
  **graphic design and visual communication**
  .
* Can independently take a creative brief from
  **concept to final execution**
  .
* Is comfortable experimenting with
  **AI-powered design and video tools**
  .
* Can use AI to improve
  **creative quality, speed, and experimentation**
  .
* Has strong attention to detail and maintains brand consistency.
* Can manage multiple projects and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Takes ownership and proactively brings
  **new creative ideas and formats**
  .
* Enjoys working in a
  **fast-paced, collaborative marketing environment**
  .

Core Requirements

The following capabilities are
**essential for this role**
:

1. **Strong Graphic Design Skills**
2. **Hands-on Video Editing Experience**
3. **Experience with AI-Powered Creative Tools**
4. **Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite**
5. **Experience with Figma or similar design tools**
6. **Strong Marketing & Brand Design Portfolio**
7. **Ability to manage multiple creative projects and deadlines**

Why Join Us?

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of
**design, marketing, video, and AI-powered creative technology**
.

You will have the opportunity to work on diverse marketing campaigns, experiment with emerging creative tools, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and create visual experiences that directly contribute to the brand and business.

If you are a designer who loves
**creating, experimenting, editing, and pushing the boundaries of modern visual communication**
, we would love to hear from you.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Create. Design. Inspire.**
As a graphic designer at Gallup, you’ll transform complex ideas, research and data into compelling visual stories that help leaders, organizations and communities make decisions and create meaningful change around the world. You’ll combine creative thinking, sophisticated design and meticulous execution to bring Gallup’s most important insights to life.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Create visually compelling designs across formats, including reports, presentations, advertisements, learning materials, social media graphics, infographics, brochures and event collateral using Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office
* Translate complex concepts, survey results and business insights into clear visual stories that support Gallup’s consulting, research and client work
* Collaborate with consultants, project managers, researchers and global design teams to understand needs, strengthen ideas and ensure designs communicate key messages while adhering to Gallup’s brand standards
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines while maintaining exceptional accuracy, consistency and design quality
* Stay ahead of design trends and experiment responsibly with AI-enabled tools to accelerate ideation, refine designs and improve production workflows

**Who We Want**

* Visual storytellers who transform complex ideas, research and data into clear, compelling designs
* Creative problem-solvers who explore possibilities, challenge conventional approaches and use sound judgment to develop sophisticated design solutions
* Dependable owners who take responsibility from brief through final delivery, maintain exacting standards and follow through on commitments when priorities compete
* Agile collaborators who listen closely, communicate effectively and build trusted partnerships with consultants, researchers, project managers and colleagues
* Curious innovators who continually develop their craft, embrace emerging technology and experiment with AI to augment creative thinking, improve efficiency and elevate design

**What You Need**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in graphic design, visual communication, communication arts, fine arts or a related field required
* At least two years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in a corporate, consulting, research, agency, publishing or professional services environment required
* Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe InDesign required
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Office skills, including experience creating client-ready presentations and visual reports required
* Strong portfolio demonstrating layout design, typography, brand consistency, digital and print design and visual storytelling required
* Experience producing infographics, data visualizations or research- or report-based graphics required
* Experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, Claude and/or similar tools in a professional setting required
* Familiarity with Figma, Adobe Express or similar design tools preferred
* Basic understanding of accessibility and inclusive design principles preferred
* A commitment to working on-site at Gallup’s Mumbai office at least three days per week required
* Eligibility to work in India required; this position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship

**What You’ll Experience**

* Mission-driven work: Make a meaningful difference in the world with your unique contributions, commitment to service and exceptional outcomes.
* An empowering culture: Collaborate with smart, passionate people who love what they do and welcome your ideas, perspectives and experiences.
* Learning and development: Grow in your career as we invest in what you do best, encourage curiosity and create an environment where it’s safe — and expected — to challenge the status quo.
* Brand strength, startup energy: Thrive in an innovative environment backed by a trusted brand.
* A vibrant workplace: Enjoy working in our prestigious workspace in Mumbai’s One World Center, with high-tech workspaces, professional concierge services, and proximity to dining and transportation options.

**About Gallup**
At Gallup, we change the world, one client at a time, through extraordinary analytics and advice on everything important facing humankind. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.
  
  
Gallup offers a robust benefits package that includes competitive pay, medical and life insurance, a retirement savings program, an employee stock ownership program, mass transit reimbursement, family-building benefits, an employee assistance program, and various reimbursements and activities that enhance our associates’ wellbeing.
  
  
Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and business needs. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive workplace.
  
  
To review Gallup’s Privacy Statement, please click this link: https://www.gallup.com/privacy. This privacy policy is meant to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can update, manage and delete your information. Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.
  
  
**Agencies:**
We are not partnering with agencies for this role, nor will we accept unsolicited résumés or be responsible for any fees or expenses related to such unsolicited résumés and/or applicants.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
**Senior Graphic Designer**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:**
4-6 years

**About the Company**

BigBrainCo is a dynamic digital agency that helps brands and content creators strengthen their online presence through innovative strategy, content creation, and data-driven insights. The company works with diverse clients across industries, developing and executing impactful social media campaigns that connect creative quality with measurable audience and business outcomes. Our team combines strategic thinking, visual storytelling, production capabilities, and performance awareness to deliver work across major digital platforms. Designers contribute directly to how clients are represented online, translating brand goals and campaign requirements into clear, engaging, and effective visual communication. Because the agency manages multiple accounts and formats, the work offers exposure to varied industries, creative challenges, and evolving brand systems. BigBrainCo values ownership, collaboration, speed, consistency, and continuous improvement. This role will join a creative environment where strong design judgment is trusted, high-visibility work is visible to clients and internal leaders, and better systems are encouraged to improve quality and delivery across the wider team.

**About the Role**

The Senior Graphic Designer owns BigBrainCo’s most demanding and high-visibility design work across client accounts while delivering the full range of visual assets required for social and content campaigns. You will design YouTube thumbnails, Instagram creatives and carousels, brand kits, style guides, reusable templates, and motion-supporting assets. The role combines hands-on execution with advanced creative judgment, ensuring every output is visually strong, platform-appropriate, brand-consistent, and aligned with performance goals such as click-through rate and audience engagement. You will review junior designers’ work, mentor newer team members, and help establish stronger design systems, SOPs, and file workflows. Close collaboration with video editing and production teams will ensure consistency between static, motion, and narrative formats. This is a growth-track opportunity for a designer ready to own complex accounts, improve how the team works, and build toward leading the Graphic Design function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own high-visibility design across client accounts, translating complex briefs into clear visual solutions that strengthen brand presence, audience engagement, and campaign performance.
* Design click-worthy YouTube thumbnails for scheduled uploads, using strong composition, hierarchy, branding, and performance awareness to support channel growth and improve CTR.
* Create Instagram static creatives and carousels that follow platform best practices while preserving visual hierarchy, brand identity, readability, and consistent audience communication.
* Build and maintain client brand kits and style guides covering typography, colour palettes, logo usage, and design language as the single source of visual truth.
* Develop editable social templates that accelerate recurring content production, reduce avoidable rework, and help the wider team deliver consistent output across accounts.
* Review junior and associate designers’ work, provide actionable feedback, and support onboarding and capability development before work reaches the Creative Head.
* Improve design SOPs, file management, and workflows while collaborating with video and production teams to maintain visual and narrative consistency across formats.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with a portfolio demonstrating strong thumbnails, social creatives, brand identity systems, and visual communication across multiple formats.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro or motion design workflows, enabling effective collaboration with video editors and production teams on crossover creative requirements.
* Strong understanding of YouTube and Instagram design requirements, including visual hierarchy, mobile readability, platform conventions, brand consistency, and creative decisions that support CTR.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain brand kits or style guides across multiple clients or brands, keeping guidance current and usable by the wider team.
* Advanced design judgment with the independence to solve complex creative briefs, manage competing priorities, and deliver polished work with minimal oversight.
* Clear, constructive communication skills for reviewing junior designers’ work, explaining design decisions, and giving feedback that improves quality and capability.

**Additional Plus**

* Prior experience in a digital, social media, or creative agency environment managing multiple client brands and fast-moving production schedules.
* Experience mentoring junior designers, contributing to team standards, or preparing for formal ownership of a Graphic Design function.
* Familiarity with performance-led creative thinking, including using audience response, content objectives, and campaign outcomes to inform visual decisions.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring 4–6 years of graphic design experience, ideally gained in an agency environment where multiple brands, deadlines, and creative standards must be managed at the same time. Your portfolio should show strong YouTube thumbnails, Instagram creatives and carousels, brand identity work, reusable templates, and motion or motion-adjacent design.
* You are highly proficient in Photoshop and Illustrator and understand how platform context changes the way visual work should be structured, read, and evaluated. You can design for click-through rate, attention, clarity, and brand impact rather than aesthetics alone.
* You are comfortable building brand kits and style guides, identifying outdated guidance, and making visual systems practical for a wider team. You work independently on complex briefs, communicate decisions clearly, and maintain quality under delivery pressure.
* You are also ready to review junior designers’ work with specific, respectful feedback and support their development. Most importantly, you bring ownership, sharp visual judgment, operational discipline, and the ambition to grow into a future Graphic Design team lead.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the agency’s most complex and high-visibility design work from day one, with direct influence on how diverse brands appear and perform across digital platforms.
* Follow a clear growth path toward leading the Graphic Design team while building leadership experience through mentorship, quality review, and design systems ownership.
* Build a varied portfolio spanning YouTube thumbnails, social campaigns, brand systems, reusable templates, motion collaboration, and high-impact client work.
* Work in a collaborative, creative, and high-energy environment where strong ideas, practical improvements, and accountable execution are valued.

**What We Offer**

* Full-time Senior Graphic Designer opportunity based in Mumbai, with ownership of high-visibility client work and meaningful creative responsibility.
* Broad exposure to brands and content creators across industries, enabling portfolio growth across social, branding, thumbnails, templates, and motion collaboration.
* Structured opportunity to influence design workflows, mentor junior talent, and progress toward leading the Graphic Design team.
* Collaborative agency culture with cross-functional exposure to strategy, content creation, video editing, production, and data-informed campaign execution.

title: Senior UI-UX Designer
description:
**Job Description**

1. Design intuitive, easy-to-use user experiences and interfaces across a range of projects and applications, from concept through final execution
2. Partner with product managers to translate business requirements and user needs into practical, scalable product designs
3. Communicate design rationale and collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are technically feasible and adhere to established standards
4. Develop and maintain wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and detailed design specifications
5. Design visual assets — logos, icons, and other UI elements — for both in-product use and marketing purposes
6. Stay current with industry trends, emerging tools, and competitor products; communicate design concepts and prototypes clearly to developers and stakeholders
7. Conduct comparative UX audits of existing applications (internal and competitor) and design improved alternatives based on findings
8. Champion and help evolve the organization's design system, ensuring consistency across products
9. Mentor junior/mid-level designers and contribute to design process improvements
10. Conduct or coordinate usability testing and synthesize user research into actionable design decisions

**Skills & Requirements**

**Core Experience**

1. 8+ years of professional UI/UX design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process
2. Deep proficiency in Figma (or equivalent tools like Sketch/Adobe XD), including auto-layout, components, variants, and prototyping
3. Proven experience designing for software products (SaaS, web apps, or enterprise platforms)
4. Hands-on experience building, contributing to, or scaling a design system (component libraries, tokens, style guides)
5. Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, and visual design fundamentals (typography, color, spacing, accessibility/WCAG standards)

**Tool Sets & Technical Familiarity**

1. Design & prototyping: Figma (Dev Mode, variables, plugins), FigJam, Framer, Principle, or ProtoPie for high-fidelity interactive prototypes
2. Design systems tooling: Storybook, Zeroheight, or similar for documenting and syncing design-to-code
3. Handoff & collaboration: Zeplin, Figma Dev Mode, Jira, Confluence, Linear
4. User research: Maze, UserTesting, Hotjar, FullStory, or similar for usability testing and behavioral analytics
5. Basic front-end literacy: working knowledge of HTML/CSS and enough JS/React vocabulary to have productive conversations with engineer about feasibility and constraints

**AI-Driven Design & Development Familiarity**

(increasingly essential at senior level)

1. Practical experience using AI tools within the design workflow — e.g., Figma AI, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney/DALL·E for concept exploration and asset generation
2. Familiarity with AI-assisted prototyping/code-gen tools (e.g., v0, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Galileo AI) to rapidly translate designs into functional prototypes or accelerate handoff
3. Understanding of how generative AI is reshaping design workflows — using it for ideation, variant generation, copywriting, and user research synthesis — while knowing where human judgment must stay central (accessibility, ethical UX, brand nuance)
4. Experience designing AI-powered product features themselves (e.g., conversational UI, recommendation surfaces, human-in-the-loop patterns) is a strong plus
5. Comfort prompting and evaluating AI outputs critically, rather than treating them as a black box

**Additional Strengths That Matter at Senior Level**

1. Strategic thinking — able to push back on requirements and advocate for the user, not just execute specs
2. Strong storytelling and presentation skills for communicating design decisions to leadership and non-design stakeholders
3. Experience working in agile/cross-functional teams with tight iteration cycles
4. Data literacy — comfortable using analytics/experiment results (A/B tests, funnel data) to inform design choices

description:

**Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal and Member Engagement**
is accountable for the IC3 membership portal, the primary channel through which members receive their membership value. **2. Key responsibilities Indicative time allocation is shown against each area. Member engagement carries the largest share, reflecting its priority.**

**2.1 Platform and technology management (20%)**

* Serve as product owner for the membership portal, maintaining a prioritised feature backlog and a quarterly release plan.
* Manage the technology vendor or internal developers against agreed service levels, including uptime, defect resolution and change requests.
* Oversee integrations with payments, email, CRM etc.

**2.2 Information architecture and user experience (15%)**

* Define and maintain the portal structure, navigation and dedicated areas for each stakeholder group.
* Ensure a mobile-first experience, with pages that load reliably on lower-bandwidth connections (if applicable).
* Apply accessibility and brand standards consistently across all pages and templates.
* Use analytics and member feedback to run at least one usability improvement per quarter.

**2.3 Content quality (25%)**

* Own a 12-month content calendar covering all three stakeholder groups, reviewed monthly.
* Publish new content at least weekly, including resources, toolkits, webinar recordings, event updates, research and member news.
* Source content from IC3 programs, conferences, partner universities, member institutions, and the content committee and manage approvals and attributions.
* Maintain a content governance policy covering ownership, review dates, archiving and quality standards.

**2.4 Operations and maintenance (10%)**

* Monitor portal health weekly, including broken links, login issues, page performance and security updates.
* Maintain accurate member records, renewal dates and access rights in coordination.
* Manage the member helpdesk for portal queries, responding within two business days.
* Ensure compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and IC3 data policies, including consent and data retention.
* Retire or refresh outdated content in a quarterly content audit.

**2.5 Member engagement (25%)**

* Design structured onboarding journeys so that every new member activates core benefits within 30 days.
* Run a recurring engagement programme of newsletters, webinars, discussion forums, polls, member spotlights and recognition.
* Segment members by type, tier and activity, and tailor communication accordingly.
* Identify inactive members through usage data and run re-engagement campaigns ahead of renewal.
* Collect member feedback through surveys at least twice a year and report findings with recommended actions.
* Build communities of practice, for example among counsellors in the same city or universities recruiting from India.

**2.6 Contribution to membership growth (5%, secondary)**

Outreach and conversion are not primary responsibilities of this role. The incumbent will support the membership team by:

* Providing portal content, case studies and demo access for outreach campaigns.
* Sharing engagement and usage insights that inform renewal and acquisition strategy.

**3. Strategic priorities for the first 12 months**

The incumbent is expected to advance the following priorities.

* **Run the portal on data.**
   Establish an engagement dashboard within the first 90 days and use it to steer content, renewals and upgrades.
* **Build for scale.**
   Prepare processes, content and support to serve approximately 4,000 member institutions, the 12-month target in the membership plan.

4.
**Qualifications and competencies**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; a qualification in instructional design, educational content design, or career & college counseling is an advantage.
* 4 to 7 years of experience managing a learning portal or online community, including at least 2 years in an ownership role.
* Hands-on proficiency with content management or membership platforms (for example WordPress, a membership plugin, or a learning management system). Coding is not required.
* Experience managing technology vendors, defining requirements and running user acceptance testing.
* Working knowledge of web analytics, email platforms and CRM tools.
* Excellent written English and strong editorial judgement.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver a content calendar on schedule.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the education sector, particularly school counseling, university admissions or international education.
* Familiarity with K-12 and the higher education landscape.

**Core competencies**

* Member-centric mindset and a service orientation.
* Analytical thinking and data-informed decision making.
* Attention to detail and quality.
* Stakeholder management across internal teams and external partners.
* Initiative, ownership and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

**5. Key performance indicators**

* Member onboarding
* Engagments
* Content quality & stakeholder relevance
* Member satisfaction & Renewals
* Service

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Product Designer, Flights & Accommodations**
At Priceline, our mission is simple: to be the best travel dealmakers in the world. As part of Booking Holdings (alongside Booking.com, Agoda, Kayak, and OpenTable). Our Product Design team takes the stress out of travel booking, turning it into simple, intuitive experiences traveller’s love using. As a Senior Product Designer for Flights & Accommodations, you won’t just be pushing pixels; you’ll be the architect of the traveller’s journey, turning ambitious ideas into high-performing reality.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
Travel is inherently complex. Using our product shouldn’t be. At Priceline, real-world user data guides our design choices, and AI is in every part of our workflow, so you’ll get from early concept to testable experience faster than ever. That leaves your time for core UX: uncovering insights, architecting seamless flows, and solving hard product problems. If you’re a strategic, tech-forward designer who loves untangling hard problems, actively experiments with emerging tools, and pairs that speed with an exacting eye for quality and taste, this role was built for you. This is a senior seat with serious ownership. Flights & Accommodations are two of our flagship products, and you won’t just be polishing a screen inside it; you’ll own an entire end-to-end journey.
  
  
**Craft Seamless Experiences**
**In this role, you will get to:**

* Design Holistic Journeys: Own an end-to-end journey within Flights & Accommodations, across the several teams that touch it, and make it hold together on responsive web, iOS, and Android. You’ll go from problem framing to high-fidelity prototypes and specs, designing the hard parts, not just the happy path.
* Master the Details: A sharp eye for hierarchy, and a talent for making dense pages feel light. You visibly raise the quality bar in your area, and you know when breaking a pattern is the right call and can defend it.
* Pioneer AI-Powered Workflows: Use AI tools (we use Claude) throughout your process so your throughput is genuinely different: a testable prototype in hours rather than a sprint. Check everything it gives you, and own every final UX decision you ship.

**Collaborate & Influence**

* Be the Connective Tissue: Turn a vague request into a clear problem, and get Product and Engineering agreed on it before you start designing. You’ll know which constraints are real and which are assumed, and bring Engineering in early enough to shape the work.
* Champion Quality: Run critique that makes other people’s work stronger, not just different, and hold the bar from concept through final build. You’ll sort out disagreements between Product and Engineering rather than waiting for someone else to.

**Listen to the Traveler**

* Uncover Insights: Write the research plan for your area and partner with our researchers as a peer rather than filing a request. You’ll read the numbers and the interviews together as a pair.
* Advocate for the User: Turn research findings into meaningful product changes, ensuring the "voice of the customer" is the loudest voice in the room. You’ll decide what a traveler needs to know and when, and cut the copy that serves the business rather than the customer.

**Scale the Vision**

* Evolve the System: Contribute patterns to Horizon properly, with their states, variants, accessibility notes, and reasoning, and then get other teams actually using them. So every team can build faster on shared standards.
* Iterate with Data: Help design the test, not just the screen in it. You’ll bring the hypothesis, the metric that should move, the metric that mustn’t get worse, and what result would make you drop the idea.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience in Product/UX design, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-step digital products, including at least one project where AI was materially part of how you worked.
* Hands-on with modern AI workflows: You use AI across your design lifecycle and can show us where, in the files: what you generated, what you overrode, and one thing it got plausibly wrong that you caught.
* Comfortable Being Measured: You’re at home in an experimentation culture. You form a hypothesis before you ship, you know what a guardrail metric is for, and you’d rather be proven wrong in two weeks than go unchallenged for a year.
* Problem-Framing Over Problem-Solving: You don’t just design screens; you decide which problem is worth designing for, get your partners aligned on it, and turn down work that won’t change anything.
* Influence Without Authority: You change minds by building the demo, bringing the proof, and picking the moment. You can lose an argument without sulking and come back with better evidence.
* Accessibility and Real-World Design: You design for edge cases as a matter of course: screen readers, low connectivity, high-stress travel. You catch accessibility problems in other people’s work during critique.
* Systems Thinking in Figma: Deeply fluent in Figma, thinking natively in tokens, variants, and component architecture so design decisions scale across platforms.
* Distributed by Default: You work well with partners in other offices and time zones, write things down, and keep a problem moving without needing everyone in the room.
* You are a relentless advocate for the customer, ensuring their needs shape our product delivery.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

title: Graphic Designer (Must Be Willing To Write SEO Content)
description:
**This is not a typical content role.**

If your instinct is to:

* Use ChatGPT to write content
* Optimize for speed over quality
* Follow templates without thinking

This role is not for you.

**About Perfect Clicks LLC - Based In New Jersey, USA**

Perfect Clicks is a performance-driven SEO and digital marketing company focused on one core mission: creating irreplaceable, human-written content that dominates Google rankings and becomes a source for AI systems. We don’t chase trends or shortcuts. We build long-term digital assets through deep research, structured thinking, and high-quality execution. Our work spans SEO, content strategy, branding, and full-funnel marketing, all tied to measurable results including rankings, traffic, and revenue growth. With over a decade of experience, hundreds of brands served, and thousands of top-ranking keywords, we operate as strategic partners—not vendors—helping businesses scale through content that compounds over time and cannot be replicated by AI.

We work with high-traffic financial platforms, e-commerce brands, media companies, startups, agencies, and enterprise clients. Since SEO content is the foundation of our business's marketing deliverables, you'll be responsible for writing high quality blog posts, articles, and case studies for a wide range of niches, including wealth management, hospitality, music therapy, pain management, finance, construction, food and restaurants, and more.

We do not:

* Produce generic SEO content
* Use AI to write blogs
* Optimize for volume

We do:

* Create specific, technical, value-driven content
* Build real expertise through human-created work
* Develop team members into strategic partners — not just writers

**The Role: Graphic Designer & Content Writer**

As graphic designer and content writer, you will start by writing — but this is not a traditional writing role.

Writing is how you:

* Learn industries deeply
* Understand client businesses
* Develop strategic thinking

This role is designed as a structured path from execution to strategy, where content writing is the foundation, not the end goal. You will begin by writing and contributing directly to client work, learning how to research, think, and produce high-quality content that drives real SEO performance. As you develop, you will move from task-based execution to owning outcomes—understanding client goals, analyzing data, and contributing to strategy. Over time, high performers transition into leadership roles, managing projects, guiding team members, and participating in client decision-making. With a clear progression from training to independent contribution to strategic direction, this role is built to develop long-term thinkers who can grow into executive-level responsibilities within 6 months to 3 years based on performance and ownership.

**LOCATION:**
Virtual

**HOURS:**
8:30 AM EST to 5 PM EST (6 PM to 2:30 AM)

**SALARY:**
6 to 10 LPA

**Career Growth Path (Year 1):**

**Bootcamp Phase (0-1 month)**

Intensive training focused on writing, research, and core frameworks. You will learn how to produce high-quality, manual content, understand industries deeply, and build the foundation for strategic thinking. This phase is about learning how to think, not just execute.

**Core Team (1-6 months)**

Transition into a full contributor role, owning content production and taking responsibility for quality, timelines, and communication. You will begin making independent decisions, improving efficiency, and developing a deeper understanding of client goals and SEO performance.

**Lead Team (6-12+ months)**

Move into strategy and leadership, managing projects, guiding team members, and contributing to client direction. You will take ownership of outcomes, including content performance, growth, and long-term strategy, while mentoring others and helping scale operations.

The goal is to become someone clients trust to make decisions and become a leader on our team, not just write blogs.

**Core Beliefs on AI Content vs. Human Content**

No generative AI tools for writing content.

* No ChatGPT
* No Gemini or Claude
* No AI-generated drafts

*If AI can write your content, you are not adding value.*

AI-generated content leads to generic output, weak differentiation, and poor long-term performance. Our goal is to create content that AI cannot replicate, only reference.

* **AI-generated writing is not allowed -**
  We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for AI-written content. It goes against our standards, our values, and the level of quality we expect.
* **AI content does not create value -**
  AI-generated content is easy to produce, but also easy to replace. It lacks originality, depth, and true expertise—making it ineffective for long-term SEO performance and client growth.
* **Human content is what AI depends on -**
  AI systems do not create knowledge—they aggregate it. The only content that holds value is original, human-created insight that AI can reference and learn from.
* **We aim to be the source, not the output -**
  Our goal is to create content that ranks on Google and is used in AI Overviews, ChatGPT responses, and other AI systems—not content that competes with them.
* **AI usage reduces learning and expertise -**
  Relying on AI shortcuts limits your ability to think, analyze, and develop real skill. Manual work builds knowledge. AI dependence prevents it.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* Create logos, images, and visual assets to carry out client branding goals
* Use photo editing, illustration, and animation software to create digital designs
* Present design concepts, layouts, and branding assets to clients
* Incorporate recommended design changes from client and CEO to meet client needs
* Select colors, typography, and typefaces to support brand narratives
* Write 1–2 high-quality blog posts daily using Perfect Clicks internal frameworks
* Translate complex information into clear, structured, user-focused content
* Conduct SEO keyword research and analysis for client sites
* Continuously refine content based on feedback and performance
* Communicate proactively with a remote team working US hours
* Contribute to long-term content strategy as you grow

**Brands, Topics, & Industries**

You will work across a wide range of brands and industries, including:

* Medical and healthcare services and procedures
* Pain management, regenerative medicine, minimally invasive surgeries
* Construction and local service industries (projects, pricing, materials)
* E-commerce and consumer products (comparisons, positioning, conversion content)
* Forex broker platforms, proprietary trading firms, and wealth management companies
* Financial markets: bonds, commodities, cryptocurrencies, stock CFDs, ETFs, indices, options
* Trading strategies, platform features, and investment analysis
* B2B SaaS platforms, software tools, and product workflows

**Benefits**

* Paid sick time
* Pain vacation time
* Paid holidays
* Flexible unpaid time off

**We are not looking for:**

* Generic SEO writers
* People who want easy, repetitive work
* Candidates who rely on AI tools

**We are looking for:**

**Quality-First Thinkers -**
You get frustrated by generic content, care about doing things properly, and notice when something is off.

**Methodical Learners**
- You ask questions before starting, want to understand why, and take time to do things right.

**High Ownership Individuals**
- You communicate proactively, do not cut corners, and take responsibility for outcomes.

**Long-Term Builders**
- You want to develop real skills, grow into strategy, and are willing to do hard things now for long-term growth.

**Who Should Not Apply**

* You prefer using AI tools for writing
* You prioritize speed over quality
* You struggle with detailed feedback
* You avoid asking questions
* You want quick, low-effort work

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most companies want more content, faster, and use AI to scale output. We are doing the opposite.

We believe the future belongs to people who think first, not people who prompt first.

**Growth and Opportunity**

* Direct mentorship and structured feedback
* Clear path from execution to strategy
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership
* Long-term role for high performers

**Remote Work**

* Fully remote
* Must be comfortable working US hours (8:30 AM – 5 PM EST / 6 PM – 2:30 AM IST)
* Strong communication is required

**Qualifications**

* Excellent English writing, grammar, and communication skills
* 3+ years of experience in content writing, journalism, or a related field
* Ability to break down complex financial or technical topics
* Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to work independently and collaborate in a remote environment
* Positive, accountable, and growth-oriented mindset

**Hiring Process**

The role of the Instructional Designer is to design, develop, and deliver engaging and pedagogically sound learning experiences for distance and online learners. The incumbent will collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs), faculty, and content teams to translate academic material into effective, learner-centric instructional designs. * Keen eye for detail and appreciation of great design

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
Most brand content moves. Very little of it moves people. Feeds are full of the same templates, the same transitions and the same AI videos that all look like they came from one prompt. We’re looking for someone who finds that boring and wants to do better: someone who can take a static logo, a product or a plain idea and make it move in a way people actually stop for, whether that means keyframes, a 3D render or an AI-generated scene. You don’t need a long CV. You need a showreel that makes us hit replay. If you think in keyframes, lighting setups and prompts, this one is for you.

**About Idea Simplified**

Idea Simplified is a Mumbai-based experiential IP Creation & brand consulting agency. We help brands work out what they stand for, simplify how they say it and build the strategy and content that gets them noticed.

Our work is about clarity: sharper positioning, stronger stories and communication that lands. Motion, 3D and AI video are how we make that clarity impossible to scroll past, and that’s where you come in.

**This is for you if:**

→ You’ve paused a Reel just to work out how a transition was done

→ You care about easing curves the way other people care about fonts

→ You can make a product look premium with light, texture and camera movement

→ You’ve spent hours getting one AI shot exactly right, and enjoyed it

→ You know where AI speeds up the work and where real craft has to take over

→ You keep a folder of personal experiments nobody asked you to make

**This is not for you if:**

→ Every project you make starts with the same preset

→ You think AI video means typing one prompt and exporting whatever comes out

→ You think motion is decoration, not storytelling

→ Feedback and revisions feel like personal attacks

→ You struggle to finish work on deadline

→ Render time (or generation time) is your excuse for everything

**What You’ll Do**

Motion Graphics

* Create motion graphics for social media, brand films, ads and presentations
* Animate logos, typography, infographics and brand elements
* Design transitions, titles and visual effects for short-form video
* Turn static brand assets into motion systems that stay consistent across campaigns

3D Design

* Build 3D models, product visualisations and animated product films
* Handle lighting, texturing and rendering to a high standard
* Create 3D assets for social content, campaigns and brand communication

AI Video

* Produce AI-generated videos for social content, ads and brand campaigns
* Write and refine prompts to get consistent characters, styles and scenes across shots
* Combine AI footage with motion graphics, 3D and live footage into polished final edits
* Use AI tools to speed up concepting, storyboards, mood films and pitch visuals
* Keep up with new AI video tools and test what’s worth adding to our workflow
* Make sure AI output stays on-brand and meets client quality standards

Concept & Collaboration

* Work with strategists and copywriters to turn ideas into visual concepts
* Create styleframes and quick animatics before going into production
* Take feedback, revise fast and deliver in the right formats for each platform
* Manage several projects at once without dropping quality

**How to Apply**

Apply here, or send your CV and showreel/ portfolio to mohit@ideasimplified.com with the subject line “Make it move”.

Put your strongest piece of work. Add a one-line note on what you did in each project and which pieces used AI tools. Skip the cover letter. Your reel is the cover letter.

title: Principal Designer- Cad - Aviation
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly detailed and technically skilled
**Civil CAD Designer (Aviation)**
to join our aviation engineering team. In this role, you will play a critical part in the development, modification, and management of complex 2D and 3D civil engineering design models and construction drawings for commercial, military, and general aviation airports. You will collaborate closely with senior aviation engineers, project managers, and airport stakeholders to translate design concepts into precise technical packages for runways, taxiways, aprons, drainage systems, and airfield utilities.
  
  
**You will join our Aviation department:**
As our new
**CAD Designer, Civil**
, you will work with the team to deliver work in close collaboration with Ramboll colleagues based across the business. You will be part of the Aviation team in India. You will work as part of a lively team, filled with people who are really excited about creating the solutions for the future. Our team is vibrant, innovative, international, and supportive. You will collaborate with your colleagues to play a critical role in defining and delivering projects. Based on a strong future pipeline of work we are now looking to expand the team. The role requires an inquisitive mind, capable of developing innovative and sustainable outcomes to support our clients.
  
  
Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:
  
  
  

* Development and review of 2D and 3D construction drawings
* Work under the supervision of senior staff to assist drafting design efforts for military and commercial airfields including, but not limited to, such disciplines as earthwork, pavements, and drainage
* Work closely on project assignments with those of other engineers and technicians in his/her discipline group
* Provide support in the overall management of construction drawings for projects
* Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate across teams and handle shifting project deadlines in a fast-paced consulting environment.

**Qualifications**
From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:
  
  
  

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Drafting Technology, or related discipline
* 6+ years of experience in CAD production for civil infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in aviation/airport projects is preferred.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and relevant BIM tools, working knowledge of MicroStation preferred.
* Knowledge of airport design standards, civil engineering drawing practices, and construction documentation.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments.
* Strong communication, coordination, and leadership skills.

**Additional Information**
**Welcome to our Transport division**
Ramboll is a global transportation consultancy and we work on some of the biggest and most innovative infrastructure projects in the world. We are close to 3,000 bright minds working within Transport worldwide, creating practical, sustainable and economic solutions for national transport authorities, private contractors and municipalities alike.
  
  
**Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include:**
self-motivated, solution mindset, attention to detail. A team player with ability to work independently with minimum supervision Flexible attitude, in agile environment with frequently changing deadlines can be relied on to meet deadlines, committed to both their work and personal development, with a willingness to widen their experience, including knowledge base and leadership skills. Good communication skills both written and verbal
  
  
  

* The ability to build relationships and trust, so your business colleagues see you as their partner, focusing on creating value for the business.
* The ability to understand and navigate a complex, relationship-based matrix organization to achieve key objectives.
* Being able to adopt a team-oriented approach to solving problems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What we can offer you
  
  
  

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

We offer:
  
  
  

* A challenging and interesting workday characterized by continuous learning, in an environment where you have many to spar with and learn from.
* Opportunity to work with varied work tasks, across the organization.
* Opportunity to develop and influence your own area of responsibility.

Ready to join us?
  
  
Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.
  
  
**Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion**
Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

We’re looking for a
**Senior Website Developer & Designer**
who can own the full digital lifecycle; from initial UX wireframing and high-end UI design to clean front-end code and performance optimization for a portfolio of high-impact B2B and D2C brands.

You’ll craft bespoke digital experiences, lead complex web builds, and integrate cutting-edge AI-driven workflows into your design and coding stack.

You’ll set the technical and aesthetic direction, manage full-stack implementation across client platforms, and be the go-to person for seamless interaction design, flawless responsiveness, and bulletproof deployment.

  Establish and maintain high-performance, visually stunning website architectures that scale seamlessly across devices and align perfectly with client brand identities.

  Use advanced AI tools (beyond ChatGPT & Gemini) for code scaffolding, UX research synthesis, copywriting placeholders, component generation, and rapid prototyping to accelerate delivery without sacrificing craft.

  Rigorously optimize site speed, mobile responsiveness, accessibility (WCAG standards), and on-page SEO metrics.

  Maintain an uncompromising standard of craft while thriving in a fast-paced agency environment with strict launch timelines.
* **Client Collaboration:**
  Present design prototypes and technical architectures to internal teams and clients, articulate technical choices clearly, and incorporate feedback gracefully.

* A robust portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of sophisticated websites (from design concept to live production code).
* Expert-level command of UI/UX design tools (Figma, Framer, Wix) and modern front-end web development stack (HTML/CSS/JS, Tailwind, React/Next.js, or advanced Webflow/Wix/Framer architecture).

* **Deep understanding of web performance metrics, conversion rate optimization (CRO), SEO, and cross-browser compatibility.**

* Competitive Pay aligned with your portfolio and leadership experience.
* Creative Freedom to experiment with new formats and technologies.
* AI-First Environment: We invest in paid AI tools for the team, so you’re not stuck on free trials.
* **Growth & Incentives: Clear pathways for pay raises and project-based bonuses.**
* Supportive Culture: A drama-free, collaborative team that values your craft and your time.
