title: Instructional Designer & Digital Learning Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Instructional Designer \& Digital Learning Manager to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical maritime engineering, safety compliance, and cutting\-edge digital education. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying highly interactive, high\-retention digital learning modules. Your content will train both shore\-based corporate teams and seafarers deployed globally on our vessels.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how adult brains learn and can translate dense technical manuals or safety management systems (SMS) into modern, engaging digital formats optimized for low\-bandwidth and offline environments.
   

  

 We expect the person to be able to liaise with external vendors for quick content development and hence knowledge of industry practices is appreciated.
   

  

 The position is also expected to actively participate in upgrade of our existing Learning Management System and will be responsible for management of the same.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Content Design \& Development: Create interactive e\-learning modules, micro\-learning assets, video explainers, and simulation\-based courses using Articulate 360 (Storyline/Rise) and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Technical Translation: Collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)—including Marine Superintendents, Chief Engineers, and Safety Managers—to convert complex maritime regulations (IMO, MARPOL), engineering blueprints, and operational workflows into clear training content.
* Low\-Bandwidth Optimization: Architect digital packages (SCORM) specifically designed and compressed for smooth deployment on onboard vessel networks and mobile devices with limited internet connectivity.
* Multimedia Production: Script, film, record, and edit high\-quality instructional videos, animations (using Vyond or After Effects), graphic assets, and audio narration.
* Assessment \& Evaluation: Design rigorous, scenario\-based evaluations that measure practical decision\-making and compliance competency, bridging digital learning with onboard physical drills.
* LMS Maintenance: Package and publish courses according to e\-learning standards, ensuring seamless tracking, scoring, and data synchronization with our centralized Crewing and HR systems.


**Requirements:**
* Experience: 3\+ years of experience in instructional design and digital content creation. Experience within maritime, logistics, heavy engineering, aviation, oil \& gas, or defense sectors is highly preferred.
* Instructional Design Mastery: Strong foundation in adult learning theories (ADDIE, SAM, Gagne’s Nine Events) with a proven ability to architect micro\-learning frameworks.
* Authoring Tools: Expert\-level proficiency in Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) or Adobe Captivate.
* Multimedia Skills: Hands\-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) and animation software like Vyond.
* Deep understanding of LMS platforms and features
* Technical \& Spatial Literacy: Ability to read technical documentation, process flowcharts, and spatial layouts to build accurate procedural training.
* Project Management: Excellent consultative soft skills to interview busy SMEs, handle stakeholder feedback loops, and manage multiple course development timelines simultaneously.


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Corporate Training, or a related field.
* Familiarity with maritime safety frameworks (SMS) and seafaring competence standards.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted tools for rapid storyboarding, voiceovers, or asset generation.


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

 IMPORTANT: TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, PLEASE FILL THE BELOW FORM \& SUBMIT YOUR RESUME, PORTFOLIO \& ANY RELEVANT LINKS FOR REFERENCE.
 



  





**Application Form:\-** 
 https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ns9isS\-W22D2NMqBoQeGOjPufcqLIrdUMg3zWqiMBRQ/edit 
 



  





**About Us:** 




 Unstitched is a dynamic Next Gen Content, CGI \& AI Studio that specializes in creating visually stunning and immersive animations for a wide range of industries. We bring products and ideas to life through innovative design and storytelling, helping our clients connect with their audiences in meaningful ways. Our team is passionate about creativity, collaboration, and delivering exceptional results.
 



 We are building our proprietary Tech platform
 **One Click Co.** 
 a platform focused on simplifying content creation using AI where we enable users to generate high\-quality creative outputs quickly and efficiently through structured systems.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a talented and curious
 **UI/UX Designer** 
 to work on a new technology\-led AI digital product.
 



 You will work closely with the founding team to translate product ideas, user requirements and complex workflows into experiences that feel
 **simple, intuitive and beautifully designed** 
 .
 



 This role is ideal for someone who has strong visual taste, enjoys solving product problems, and wants the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a digital product.
 



 You do
 **not** 
 need extensive years of experience. We care much more about the quality of your thinking, your design sensibility and your ability to learn quickly.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Translate product requirements into clear user journeys and flows
* Create wireframes, user flows and interactive prototypes
* Design polished, modern web application interfaces
* Simplify complex workflows into intuitive user experiences
* Design dashboards, workspaces, forms, onboarding flows and interactive product experiences
* Develop and maintain reusable components and design systems in Figma
* Think through different user states, edge cases, loading states and interactions
* Work closely with the founding team to rapidly explore and iterate on ideas
* Take designs from rough concepts through to developer\-ready specifications
* Review implemented designs and help maintain visual consistency
* Explore new interaction patterns for AI\-powered digital products



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–3 years of experience in UI/UX, product design or a related role
* Strong command of
 **Figma \& other AI tools**
* Good understanding of typography, spacing, layout, hierarchy and visual systems
* Ability to design clean, modern and premium\-looking interfaces
* Understanding of UX fundamentals and user\-centered design
* Ability to think beyond individual screens and understand complete user journeys
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to explain the reasoning behind design decisions
* Comfortable working independently and iterating quickly
* Curious about technology, AI and emerging digital experiences



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience designing SaaS or web applications
* Experience with AI\-powered products
* Experience with ecommerce or consumer technology
* Experience creating or working with design systems
* Strong prototyping skills
* Familiarity with responsive web design
* Familiarity with Framer or similar tools
* Basic understanding of how designs are handed off to developers
* Interest in branding, visual design and creative technology



  





**The Kind of Designer We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking only for someone who can make screens look attractive.
 



 We're looking for someone who naturally asks:
 



**What is the user trying to achieve?** 




**Can this interaction be simpler?** 




**What information should the user see first?** 




**What should happen next?** 




**How can we make a complex technology feel effortless to use?** 




 You should enjoy thinking about both
 **how a product works and how it looks** 
 .
 



  





**What You'll Get** 



* Direct involvement in important product decisions
* Significant creative ownership
* Opportunity to design a technology product from the ground up
* Exposure to AI\-driven product experiences
* Freedom to propose and experiment with new ideas
* Close collaboration with the founding team
* Opportunity to grow with the product and take on greater design ownership over time



  





 We're particularly interested in seeing
 **real product thinking** 
 , not only polished final screens.
 



 If you're a thoughtful designer with strong visual instincts and enjoy turning complicated ideas into simple experiences, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 \*\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

description:
**Who We Are:** 




 Cimpress is the world leader in mass customization. Through our technology, production, and supply chain capabilities, Cimpress businesses make it possible for customers around the world to personalize physical products and have them manufactured on demand with high quality, speed, reliability, and affordability.
 



 As a global, remote\-first organization, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and high\-performing workplace.
 



 About the Role:
 



 The Creative Automation Designer will be responsible for creating scalable, flexible, and production\-ready design solutions that can adapt across multiple products, formats, sizes, content variations, and customer requirements.
 



 The role combines strong visual design expertise with dynamic design systems, responsive layouts, auto\-layout, reusable components, AI\-powered creative workflows, and production knowledge.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to transform static creative concepts into intelligent, reusable, and scalable design solutions.
 



 You will collaborate closely with Creative Operations, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams to bridge creative design with technical implementation and help build efficient, future\-ready creative workflows.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Dynamic \& Scalable Design** 



* Create visually compelling and production\-ready designs for print, packaging, promotional products, branding, and digital applications.
* Develop dynamic templates and scalable layouts that adapt across products, formats, sizes, content, and customer requirements.
* Transform static designs into flexible, reusable, and scalable design solutions by defining clear layout and content behavior rules.
* Identify opportunities to improve scalability by converting repetitive design activities into reusable templates, components, and workflows.



**Auto Layout \& Responsive Design** 



* Develop layouts using auto\-layout, responsive design, constraints, grids, and component\-based principles.
* Define how layouts respond to changes in content, text length, image dimensions, product sizes, and available space.
* Establish rules for resizing, reflow, stacking, wrapping, positioning, spacing, and content priority.
* Ensure designs maintain visual hierarchy, usability, consistency, and quality across digital, print, and product formats.



**Design Systems \& Component Libraries** 



* Create and maintain design systems, component libraries, templates, visual assets, and design standards.
* Develop reusable components for typography, color, imagery, icons, grids, spacing, and layouts.
* Establish design rules that support consistency, scalability, and reuse across products and business units.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to translate design components and specifications into dynamic design systems and platforms.



**AI\-Powered Creative \& Automation** 



* Leverage Generative AI and AI\-powered creative tools for ideation, asset creation, variations, enhancement, retouching, and adaptation.
* Evaluate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure quality, accuracy, originality, and brand consistency.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI and automation into creative workflows to improve productivity, scalability, and quality.
* Experiment with emerging creative technologies and contribute to AI\-assisted workflows and best practices.



**Visual Design, Print \& Production** 



* Apply strong principles of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, color, grids, spacing, branding, and design consistency.
* Create designs that balance creative quality, scalability, usability, and production requirements.
* Apply knowledge of print production, packaging, substrates, dielines, color management, resolution, finishing, and manufacturing constraints.
* Ensure outputs are technically accurate and suitable for automated, personalized, and large\-scale production.



**Collaboration \& Implementation** 



* Collaborate with Creative, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams to understand requirements and deliver effective design solutions.
* Translate creative concepts into clear design rules, specifications, components, and implementation requirements.
* Partner with technical teams to ensure design intent is accurately translated into dynamic and scalable systems.
* Participate in design reviews, prototyping, experimentation, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.



**Quality \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Maintain high standards of visual quality, consistency, accuracy, scalability, and production readiness.
* Review dynamic templates and outputs to identify layout, typography, imagery, responsiveness, and production issues.
* Establish and follow quality standards for dynamic design and template production.
* Continuously identify opportunities for standardization, automation, AI adoption, and workflow optimization.



  





  





**Your Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, UI/UX, or a related field.
* **3–5\+** 
 years of professional experience in graphic, visual, template, dynamic, or production design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating dynamic layouts, templates, responsive design, and production\-ready creative work.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, visual hierarchy, color, spacing, composition, grids, and brand consistency.
* Strong understanding of responsive layouts, auto\-layout, constraints, components, and reusable design patterns.
* Ability to translate designs into rules, logic, templates, and reusable components that can scale across formats, sizes, products, and customer requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
* Experience creating adaptable layouts, templates, design variations, and reusable visual assets for print and digital applications.
* Practical experience with Generative AI and AI\-powered creative tools for ideation, image generation, variations, enhancement, retouching, and production acceleration.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs and maintain quality, accuracy, brand consistency, and production standards.
* Willingness to continuously learn and adopt AI, automation, and emerging creative technologies.
* Understanding of how design systems and creative assets can support scalable and automated production workflows.
* Experience with Figma, Adobe Firefly, Canva, or other Generative AI tools will be an added advantage.
* Experience with design systems, component libraries, style guides, and automated creative workflows.
* Experience in e\-commerce, print, packaging, or high\-volume design operations.



  





  





**Why You'll Love Working Here:** 




 At Cimpress, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to scalable creative solutions that connect design, technology, automation, and AI.

title: Structural Design Engineer (RCC)
description:
**Company Description** 




 Flood Precast, established in 1979, specializes in precast concrete products with a strong focus on precast concrete structures. Through continuous research and development, the company has expanded its capabilities and product range to serve diverse construction needs. Flood Flooring is now recognized as the largest producer of precast concrete flooring in the UK and Irish markets. The company is committed to quality, innovation, and reliable delivery, offering robust engineering solutions to support modern infrastructure projects.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This full\-time Structural Design Engineer (RCC) role at Flood Precast India is an on\-site position based in Mumbai. The role involves performing structural analysis and design of reinforced concrete components and precast systems for residential and commercial projects. The engineer will prepare detailed design calculations, drawings, and specifications, and ensure compliance with relevant codes and standards. Daily tasks include using tools such as AutoCAD and Tekla Structures/Tekla Structures Designer for modelling, detailing and analysis, coordinating with project managers, architects, and site teams, and reviewing designs for safety, durability, and constructability. The role also includes assisting in value engineering, supporting technical documentation, and contributing to continuous improvement of design processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Strong foundation in Structural Engineering and Civil Engineering, with the ability to design RCC and precast concrete elements.
* Proficiency in Structural Analysis using relevant software and methods to assess loads, stability, and performance.
* Structural Analysis \& Modelling: Develop and analyse structural models using appropriate software to evaluate load combinations, connections, and structural behaviour of precast systems.
* Knowledge of Eurocodes and standards applicable to RCC and precast structures.
* Ability to interpret architectural and structural drawings and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with attention to accuracy and detail.
* Relevant industry experience in building or infrastructure projects; precast concrete experience is an advantage.



  





  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




 •     
 
 M.Tech in Structural Engineering.
 




 •     
 
 Minimum 4 years of experience in RCC structural design with exposure to precast construction or in\- situ construction.
 




 •     
 
 Proficiency in Tekla Structures Designer and other design software.
 




 •     
 
 Strong knowledge of RCC design principles and seismic design.
 




 •     
 
 Good communication and coordination skills required; a strong hold on English will be an advantage.
 




  





**Preferred Skills** 




 •     
 
 Exposure to precast structures or BIM workflows.
 




 •     
 
 Familiarity with international codes (Eurocode / BS) is an advantage.
 




 •     
 
 Experience in a structural design consultancy environment.
 




  





**Salary** 



* **Salary:** 
 Highly competitive, above industry benchmarks — reflecting your expertise and experience in precast structural design.
* **Growth:** 
 Clear career progression path within a fast\-growing precast construction leader.
* **Work Environment:** 
 Opportunity to work on landmark precast projects with exposure to international design codes (Eurocode/BS) and modern BIM workflows.

 **Experiment. Create. Fail. Rework. Repeat.**

 🧠

 *“I could make that better”*

**Come create what’s next with us.**

title: Graphic Designer
description:
***Graphic Designer***




**Company:** 
  Submarine Pens Ltd. 
 



**Location:** 
  Vasai, Mumbai, Maharashtra (On\-site) 
 



**Job Type:** 
  Full\-time 
 



**Experience:** 
  Freshers to experienced —
 **portfolio matters more than years** 




  





***About the Role***




*Submarine Pens Ltd* 
**.** 
 is looking for a Graphic Designer to shape how our brands look, feel, and tell their story, across packaging and communication design. We're less focused on years of experience and more on whether your work has a distinct point of view: strong storytelling instincts, a good eye for aesthetics, and the range to move between different brand personalities without losing craft.
 



 You'll be working across a portfolio of brands with different visual identities, so versatility matters as much as individual style.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***



* Design packaging for a range of product lines \- from concept through print\-ready files, with an understanding of materials, finishes, and production constraints.
* Design communication assets: social media creatives, brand decks, website visuals, retail collateral, and campaign material
* Translate brand positioning and tone into visual language — you'll be handed a brand's story and personality, and need to design something that actually feels like it
* Maintain visual consistency and brand guideline compliance across multiple sub\-brands with distinct identities
* Collaborate with the marketing team on creative direction for launches and campaigns
* Occasionally support building out visual identity systems for new product lines or brand extensions



  





***Requirements***



* A strong portfolio that demonstrates storytelling and aesthetic sensibility (
 *this matters more to us than a specific degree or number of years worked)*
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (CorelDraw, Illustrator, Photoshop, at minimum)
* Understanding of print production fundamentals for packaging (dielines, CMYK, finishes, material considerations)
* Ability to work across multiple visual identities without diluting brand distinctiveness
* Good instincts for composition, typography, and colour — the kind of eye that's hard to teach.



  





***Preferred Qualifications***



* Prior experience designing for premium or luxury brands
* Familiarity with retail packaging specifically
* Basic motion graphics or video editing skills.
* Experience working across a multi\-brand portfolio



  





***What We Offer***



* Exposure to both packaging and communication design, rather than being siloed into one
* Room to bring your own aesthetic point of view to the work



  





***How to Apply***




 Please submit your portfolio (link or PDF) along with your resume. We'll be looking closely at the portfolio. Show
 
 us relevant work, that you're proudest of.
